thread:
maria: Hey team — assembling final partner inputs for the cost model. Need the following by EOD if possible: 1) typical spot blackout windows and frequency, 2) reserved instance commit lengths & granularity, 3) latency SLA deltas reserved vs spot (p90/p99), 4) when marketplace credits apply relative to reserve start. Can partners paste CSV or quick bullets? :clipboard:

aj: Quick clarifying q: can reserved SKUs be partially consumed across regions (shared pool) or are they region-locked? Also we need a price ladder for commit sizes (small/med/large) and whether discounts step at absolute GPU counts or $-commit.

liam: For infra planning: what are eviction lead times / preemption signals? e.g., do partners give a 30s GRACE, 5min, or none? Also any regular blackout windows for maintenance (weekday nightly windows?).

ryan: Marketing heads-up — joint announcement readiness depends on commit/blackout alignment. If partner blackout windows are >=24h recurring, we need to flag in co-marketing materials. :eyes:

infra-bot: Uploaded sample schema and example row: /files/partner_supply_schema_v2.csv (see sample below)

maria: sample CSV (paste into partner reply):

```
partner_id,sku,region,commit_tier,commit_term_days,commit_unit,spot_available_pct,expected_blackout_avg_hours,blackout_pattern,eviction_signal_secs,latency_delta_p90_ms,latency_delta_p99_ms,currency,price_per_unit,escalation_pct_per_yr,credits_applied_on_reserve_start,notes
zenith,zen-a100-80g,us-west-2,small,30,per-hour,60,2,weekly:Sun:02-04,300,15,60,USD,2.50,5,yes,"partial cross-region if paired pool"
```

aj: We'll map commit_term_days -> model term buckets (30,90,365) and commit_unit -> hour/day/month. Please include currency and whether price listed is net-of-credits or gross.

liam: If partners can't provide p99 numbers, a qualitative tag is fine: same|+20ms|+100ms — we'll translate to numeric deltas. Also ask for eviction signal API endpoint or channel (e.g., cloud-event, webhook).

ryan: Also capture SI integration lead time (days to onboard, days to get production traffic) — affects our go-to-market timing and estimates for joint announcements.

maria: Thanks — I'll consolidate incoming rows into a canonical sheet and run scenario sims: reserved-heavy, mixed, and ephemeral-heavy. Expect v1 of the model tomorrow morning and will ping for finance sign-off. @aj please review once I share. :thumbsup:
